protocol: Re-round at 1555027 after the round-5 REVISE fixes (floor-sheet washout, legend box, engineered-header SKU). Tree HEAD during the round was af3b846 — a board-only commit over 1555027 (docs/plans/NIGHT-BOARD.md +28, src byte-identical). Two sets generated via pure buildPlanSet (bun harness at repo root, computeLevel + injected bones:framing, LOD 400, all systems): demo-house-FL (fc866f2f271b over HTTP, 74 nodes, regression baseline, 14 sheets, 2030 members / 94 fixtures — identical counts to round 5) and a re-composed stairtower-NY (two-storey 9×6, framing node on the UPPER level lvl1: slab + 1.2×2.8 stair hole, TALL DOOR 2.4 m in the 2.5 m south wall at u=6.5, interior partition, 30° oblique trapezoid wing slab+walls east, gable roof on a separate lvlroof, PLUS a 3.4 m slider in the north wall to exercise the engineered-header SKU on paper — 13 sheets, 717 members, 41 deck strips / 61.104 m²), plus a 26-circuit legend-stress electrical sheet (demo members + 12 cloned XT circuits; 25 of the 26 draw on the electrical sheet — ac-whip-1 is system hvac and belongs to the MEP sheet) and floor-sheet A/B deck-filtered variants. 29 sheets rasterized with Playwright page.setContent at 2x and ALL walked; SVGs+stats in /tmp/bp7/, crops in /tmp/bp7/crops/.
verdict: REVISE (narrow) — all THREE round-5 focus fixes hold on paper exactly as specified: the deck now prints as layer ZERO translucent (fill-opacity 0.35, hairline #cfc4a6 seams — SVG forensics: all 41 deck rects at indices 9–49, every joist/girder rect after 55) and joists, both 4x10 girders, the doubled stair headers/trimmers, rims and blocking all read through/over it (A/B parity exhibit); the oblique-wing deck sawtooth is DEAD (max strip-corner overhang 0.87 mm = the b550986 sampling epsilon, invisible at 1:75; stepped conservative gaps inside the rim as intended); the 26-circuit legend backing rect widens to 484 px and column 2 sits ON it with the rect bottom 8 px under the last row (no overshoot, single-column demo byte-identical); the engineered-span slider books 'Engineered header (LVL/PSL — by supplier)' 1 pcs + 11.8 lf with NO dimensional 4x12 stick row, the drawn member is labeled 'drawn as 4x12 — size by supplier', and the Flags block prints every composed flag verbatim incl. the tall door's 'header 4x8 does not fit … (1.5" of 7.2") — RO head lowered 5.2cm — …'. TWO new paper defects block: (1) P4/C5 flag TRUNCATION — the schedules wrapRow caps a flag at TWO lines and ellipsizes the rest, and the post-round-5 S10 flat-roof span flag is the first text long enough to hit the cap: the pinned demo baseline (sheet 14, 3/3) prints '… purlin + 2x4 struts to bearing or engineered member…' silently dropping ' required (R802.5.1)' — the exact 'silent drop of a warning is a lie on paper' P4 forbids, on the regression demo itself; (2) upper-storey CROSS-LEVEL LIFT — elevations/section/cover lift levelId-tagged members by the ABSOLUTE storey baseY (plan-set.ts:1037,1204; production passes the raw extractLevels map, panel.tsx:846-866) while the owner's own members draw owner-local, so with the framing node on lvl1 (baseY 2.7) the lvlroof roof draws 5.4 m up instead of 2.7 — a full storey of daylight between cap plates and rafters on ALL four elevations + section + cover, and the RIDGE datum prints +7.77 m where the true owner-local ridge is +5.07 m (first upper-storey-owner set with the roof on its own level; every prior examiner scene had a ground owner where absolute == relative). Also carried OPEN from round 5: the floor sheet still has NO 'subfloor' legend row (the fix shipped the draw-order/translucency half but not the legend half — P2 verbatim, the sheet's dominant ink is unlabeled); new FLAG: the wing's mid-span BLOCKING row overhangs the 30° rim by 13.9 cm and crosses the rim joist (pre-existing bay-fill logic sampling only the bay-center line, S1-family, newly EXPOSED by the now-translucent deck — the deck itself is clean). Invariant sweep at the pin: bun test → 920 pass / 1 todo / 0 fail (921 tests, 42 files, 30,514 expect() calls), bunx tsc --noEmit clean — all gated rows green (E1-E5, S1-S10, M1/M2, P1-P5, A1-A4); the two blockers are paper classes the gates don't cover yet (each needs a row/gate with its fix per process).

FOCUS-1-floor-washout.evidence: /tmp/bp7/stairtower-NY/02-floor-framing-plan.png vs AB-floor-NO-DECK.png (every joist line survives 1:1); crops st-floor-hole.png (doubled stair headers/trimmers + hangers + girder band read over the deck), st-floor-field.png; SVG forensics: 41 deck rects (fill-opacity 0.35, stroke #cfc4a6 0.3) draw at indices 9–49, first joist rect 55, girders 59 — ALL deck under ALL framing; demo-house-FL has no floor sheet (slab-on-grade, 0 deck members) and its sheets are byte-identical to round 5 except the schedules flag delta below
FOCUS-1-floor-washout.note: The round-5 blocker is dead: layerOf(subfloor)=0 + translucency mirrors the 3D ghost class on paper. Joists print as paired #444 strokes, deck seams as tan hairlines — no longer confusable half-bay-off false lines.

FOCUS-1-subfloor-legend.evidence: stairtower floor-sheet legend rows: joist/header/rim-joist/girder/post/blocking only (SVG text scan) — 'subfloor', still the sheet's dominant ink (~61 m² of translucent fill), has no row; 'hanger' shares the gap (pre-existing, negligible)
FOCUS-1-subfloor-legend.note: Round-5 P2 FAIL carried OPEN: the recommendation said 'either way add a subfloor 3/4" T&G legend row' and 1555027 shipped only the draw-order/translucency half. Checklist row P2 (every symbol/color on a sheet appears in that sheet's legend). Legend builder derives rows from SIZED members only — add size-less roles (subfloor, hanger).

FOCUS-1b-deck-oblique-overhang.evidence: crops st-floor-wing-lower.png / st-floor-wing-upper.png (strips end inside the oblique rim, stepped white gaps INSIDE — the acceptable conservative direction); member forensics vs the wing polygon: max strip-corner overhang 0.00087 m (= the lo+0.001 sampling epsilon, 0.04 px at 1:75), main slab 8.9e-16 m; joists/girders/headers all 0 overhang
FOCUS-1b-deck-oblique-overhang.note: The b550986 lo/c/hi span intersection holds: the round-5 sawtooth past the rim is gone on a wing whose oblique edges cross the strip axis. Booked area now under-books the oblique wedges (S4-conservative, stated direction).

NEW-blocking-rim-overhang.evidence: crop st-floor-wing-stub.png: the wing's mid-span blocking line crosses the oblique rim and continues 13.9 cm OUTSIDE the slab polygon (member forensics: max blocking corner outside slab_wing = 0.1387 m over 11 blocks), passing through the rim joist on the way; engine geometry (visible in 3D too), floor-framing.ts blocking pass samples the polygon only at the bay-center line (`inside` at cross, mid) while the block fills the full bay
NEW-blocking-rim-overhang.note: Pre-existing class (bay-fill logic is round-11/round-14 era), newly EXPOSED on paper by the translucent deck — round 5 could not see through the opaque wash. S1-family (blocking × rim interpenetration) in a scenario the SAT matrix doesn't compose. Fix: clip the blocking bay span against the polygon at both row lines (the deck's lo/c/hi recipe applies verbatim) or skip bays the rim crosses; add the oblique-wing blocking scenario to interpenetration.test.ts.

FOCUS-2-legend-box.evidence: /tmp/bp7/legend-stress/05-electrical-rough-in-plan.png + SVG numbers: backing rect x=44 y=42 w=484 h=420 (bottom 462); 22 circuit rows col 1 (x=65, last baseline y=454 → 8 px pad, no overshoot), 3 rows col 2 (x=295, XT-7/8/9) fully ON the backing; every circuit drawn on the sheet has a row (25 of 25 — the 26th synthetic id ac-whip-1 is system hvac, MEP sheet); demo (14 circuits, single column) sheets byte-identical to round 5
FOCUS-2-legend-box.note: Both round-5 nicks closed: width follows the column count (484 = 2×230+24 exactly as tasked) and the height no longer double-counts wrapped rows. Minor P1 note: on the stress sheet the wider box now overlaps the plan's west context at 0.92 white — devices under it fade; a right-shifted plan transform when legendCols>1 would keep the drawing clear (stress-set composition, demo unaffected).

FOCUS-3-engineered-header-SKU.evidence: stairtower schedules 1/2: 'Wall framing · Engineered header (LVL/PSL — by supplier) — 1 pcs (exceeds prescriptive header span — see flags)' + '— 11.8 lf (lineal feet)'; NO 4x12 row anywhere (4x8 books exactly 2 pcs + 42.7 bd-ft = the two prescriptive headers); member label 'Engineered header over door (drawn as 4x12 — size by supplier)', material 'engineered'; floor girders keep dimensional rows (4x10 — 1+1 pcs, 86.7 bd-ft, drawn full size); Flags block (2/2) prints ALL FIVE flags verbatim incl. the composed 'header 4x8 does not fit between the RO and the plates (1.5" of 7.2") — RO head lowered 5.2cm — raise the wall, lower the opening, or use an engineered flat header' and 'ENGINEERED BEAM REQUIRED — exceeds prescriptive header span'
FOCUS-3-engineered-header-SKU.note: The buy-list lie is dead both ways: no bd-ft for lumber that must not be bought, a supplier line for the beam that must. Checklist S4 + P4 hold for the new class. Minor: the wall-sheet role legend prints one size per role ('header — 4x8') while a 4x12 engineered header is drawn on the same sheet — worth a '(+ engineered)' suffix or per-size rows.

NEW-flag-truncation.evidence: /tmp/bp7/crops/demo-flags-block.png — demo-house-FL schedules 3/3 prints '⚑ Flat roof joist over prescriptive span — 8.72 m horizontal projection > 3.57 m allowable (2x6 @ 24" o.c., SPF #2, R802.4.1) — purlin + 2x4 struts to bearing or engineered member…' — the engine flag ends 'engineered member required (R802.5.1)': the remedy verb and code citation are silently DROPPED. Root cause plan-set.ts wrapRow (flags wrapped at 92 chars into AT MOST two lines, remainder ellipsized) — the comment above it says 'flags still print VERBATIM, a long one just takes two lines' but any flag past ~184 chars truncates. The S10 roof-span flags (landed 143b9a4/776624a, AFTER round-5's pin) are the first texts long enough; this is the PINNED DEMO BASELINE, not a synthetic stress
NEW-flag-truncation.note: Checklist rows P4 ('engine warnings print verbatim … a silent drop of a warning is a lie on paper') + BLUEPRINTS C5 (flags list intact) — the round-3 fix removed the LIST cap but left a per-flag LINE cap. Blocker. Fix: loop wrapRow for flag texts (n lines, no ellipsis) and count the real line total in the reserve; gate: the exact S10 flat-roof text prints every word.

NEW-upper-storey-roof-lift.evidence: stairtower 07/08/09/10 elevations + 11 section + 01 cover: the lvlroof gable (rafters/ridge/ceiling joists/collar ties, levelId-tagged) floats a FULL STOREY above the cap plates — datums print RIDGE +7.77 m / T.O. PLATE +2.48 m where the true owner-local ridge is +5.07 m (roof members lift by levelBaseY['lvlroof']=5.4 instead of 5.4−2.7 relative to the OWNER lvl1); plan-set.ts:1037+1204 `lift = levelBaseY[m.levelId] ?? 0` with owner members drawn owner-local on the same sheet; production passes the raw absolute map (panel.tsx ExportPlansButton, extractLevels(...).baseY). Round-5's stairtower did not catch it (its roof lived on the owner level); every earlier examiner scene had a GROUND owner where absolute == relative
NEW-upper-storey-roof-lift.note: A plans examiner bounces a set whose roof hovers 2.7 m over the walls with a wrong ridge datum. A3-adjacent paper class (the renderer mounts by level group natively and is unaffected; sheets must mirror the SAME relative arithmetic). Fix: pass the owner level id into buildPlanSet (or pre-rebase the map: baseY[l] − baseY[owner]) so lift = storey DELTA; gate: upper-storey-owner scene pins the drawn ridge y at owner-local height on section + elevation. The same rebasing decides the sub-grade girder-post/'GRADE 0.00m' semantics carried from round 5 (N2/A3 advisory — posts to the storey below still read as buried piles).

REG-demo-baseline.evidence: 13 of 14 demo sheets byte-IDENTICAL to the round-5 SVGs (cmp); the single delta is schedules 3/3 gaining the honest new S10 flat-roof span flag (truncated — see NEW-flag-truncation); counts 2030 members / 94 fixtures / 14 circuits match round 5 exactly; CU tag + two-column-safe legend + section poché + A-A marks + datums + SHEET n/14 title blocks all unchanged
REG-demo-baseline.note: The three fixes are surgically scoped: zero drift on the ground-owner baseline. S10's flag addition is the only engine delta reaching the demo's paper.

ACCURACY-spot-checks.evidence: A1: a 6 m deck strip draws 302.4 px vs 302.36 expected at 1:75 (≤0.02% error); A2/C5: subfloor 21 sheets == ceil(61.104 m² / 2.973 m²), schedules path == panel path == 21 (stats.json both rows); A3: north arrows + consistent orientation across the stairtower set; C6: NY title block '2025 Residential Code of New York State (2024 IRC base), effective 2025-12-31' + SHEET n/13 on every sheet; C2: all 8 stairtower circuits traceable with legend rows (7 branch + SE), devices wired; C4: STUDS @ 16" O.C. U.N.O. + RAFTERS @ 24" O.C. callouts, headers/kings distinguishable
ACCURACY-spot-checks.note: C1: every system with members got its sheet (13). The unroofed wing is 19% of the footprint — under the 25% roof-coverage warning threshold, so no flag prints (rule as shipped; the demo's own coverage flag still prints). P1 carried: plan sheets right-biased with a large empty west margin; schedules 1/2 bottom half empty (pagination balance, carried since round 3).

SWEEP.evidence: bun test at the pin (HEAD af3b846 = 1555027 + board-only commit): 920 pass / 1 todo / 0 fail — 921 tests across 42 files, 30,514 expect() calls; bunx tsc --noEmit clean
SWEEP.note: All checklist gates green: E1-E5, S1-S10, M1/M2, P1-P5, A1-A4. No GATED row regressed. The two FAILs are ungated paper classes (P4-truncation, upper-storey lift) — per process each needs a row/gate landed with its fix; the blocking-overhang FLAG needs the oblique-wing SAT scenario.

recommendations: FLAG TRUNCATION (blocker): make wrapRow's flag path loop — wrap at 92 chars to AS MANY lines as the text needs, never ellipsize; the reserve already counts flagLines.length so pagination absorbs it. Gate: the S10 flat-roof span text (195 chars) prints every word incl. 'required (R802.5.1)' on a schedules sheet.

UPPER-STOREY LIFT (blocker): rebase the cross-level lift to the OWNER storey — pass ownerLevelId into buildPlanSet (or rebase levelBaseY before passing: v − baseY[owner]) so lift = baseY[m.levelId] − baseY[owner]; ground owners are unchanged (owner baseY 0). Gate: upper-storey-owner scene pins the section/elevation ridge y and the RIDGE datum at owner-local height. Decide the 'GRADE 0.00m' label semantics for non-ground sets in the same pass (round-5 N2/A3 carry: 'LEVEL DATUM +2.70m' would stop the buried-pile read of storey-below girder posts).

SUBFLOOR LEGEND (round-5 carry): legend rows for size-less roles — 'subfloor 3/4" T&G (translucent)' + 'hanger' on the floor sheet; gate: every role drawn on a sheet has a legend row (walk PLAN_SHEETS fills).

BLOCKING OVERHANG: clip each mid-span block's bay span against the slab polygon at the blocking line's both edges (the deck's lo/c/hi intersect recipe) and drop/shorten bays the rim crosses; add oblique-wing blocking × rim to the interpenetration matrix.

Minors: wall-sheet role legend one-size-per-role hides the drawn 4x12 engineered header ('header — 4x8'); MEP line-set stroke lacks a legend row; legend-stress composition — shift the plan transform right when legendCols > 1 so the 484 px box never sits over west-wing devices; P1 right-bias + schedules bottom-half emptiness carried.
